scenarios.repeatedBatch: Per-case repeat count specified in cases
scenarios.oneShot: Fresh process with --repeat 1 on every same binary/input

scope: Fresh confirmation on two new sizes per workload, not another selection. The already frozen training k=1 winner is compared only with C-O2. The same Bend-emitted artifacts, adapter, Clang and runner source are authenticated. Each guarded runtime checks every invocation and the complete batch checksum. Held-out observations cannot change the selected policy.

summary.accounting: k1CostSeconds sums per-size emission+compile+link+one execution batch, matching the original k=1 model. This charges a hypothetical independent build for each size. reusedBuildCostSeconds instead charges one build per workload and executes both repeated batches. oneShotK1CostSeconds uses a separate fresh process with repeat=1 for each size; it is not inferred by dividing batch time. One-shot observations do not select a policy and are not cold filesystem-cache measurements. Emission is the original single observation, not freshly measured. Common runner acquisition is reported separately; it and harness/reference/supervision costs are excluded from both cost models.
